title: "06_validate_grade_associated_MOFA2_factors"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-11"
---
Purpose:
1. Validate Factor5 and Factor6 using Grade II vs Grade III only
2. Exclude “Cell type not determined”
3. Export statistical results
4. Save publication/PPT-ready plots
5. Export samples ranked by Factor5/Factor6
6. Extract top positive and negative weights for Factor5/6

# Aim

This analysis validates the grade-associated MOFA2 factors identified from the clinical association analysis.

The prior analysis identified Factor5 and Factor6 as the strongest clinically associated factors, both linked to histologic grade. Here, we perform a focused validation by excluding samples labeled as "Cell type not determined" and testing only:

- Grade II
- Grade III

This provides a cleaner biological comparison.

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_grade <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(y))
  out[grepl("Grade II", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade II"
  out[grepl("Grade III", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade III"
  out[grepl("not determined", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- NA_character_

  out
}

wilcox_effect_summary <- function(dt, factor_col, group_col = "Grade_clean") {
  tmp <- dt[
    !is.na(get(group_col)) &
      get(group_col) %in% c("Grade II", "Grade III") &
      is.finite(get(factor_col))
  ]

  tmp[, (group_col) := factor(get(group_col), levels = c("Grade II", "Grade III"))]

  if (nrow(tmp) < 5 || length(unique(tmp[[group_col]])) < 2) {
    return(data.table(
      Factor = factor_col,
      Comparison = "Grade II vs Grade III",
      N_total = nrow(tmp),
      N_Grade_II = sum(tmp[[group_col]] == "Grade II"),
      N_Grade_III = sum(tmp[[group_col]] == "Grade III"),
      Median_Grade_II = NA_real_,
      Median_Grade_III = NA_real_,
      Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII = NA_real_,
      Wilcoxon_P = NA_real_,
      Note = "Too few samples or only one group"
    ))
  }

  x <- tmp[[factor_col]]
  g <- tmp[[group_col]]

  test <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x ~ g))

  med_ii <- median(x[g == "Grade II"], na.rm = TRUE)
  med_iii <- median(x[g == "Grade III"], na.rm = TRUE)

  data.table(
    Factor = factor_col,
    Comparison = "Grade II vs Grade III",
    N_total = nrow(tmp),
    N_Grade_II = sum(g == "Grade II"),
    N_Grade_III = sum(g == "Grade III"),
    Median_Grade_II = med_ii,
    Median_Grade_III = med_iii,
    Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII = med_iii - med_ii,
    Wilcoxon_P = test$p.value,
    Note = NA_character_
  )
}

make_grade_plot <- function(dt, factor_col, out_file) {
  tmp <- dt[
    !is.na(Grade_clean) &
      Grade_clean %in% c("Grade II", "Grade III") &
      is.finite(get(factor_col))
  ]

  tmp[, Grade_clean := factor(Grade_clean, levels = c("Grade II", "Grade III"))]

  p <- ggplot(
    tmp,
    aes(
      x = Grade_clean,
      y = .data[[factor_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(factor_col, " score by histologic grade"),
      subtitle = "Grade II vs Grade III only; cell type not determined excluded",
      x = "Histologic grade",
      y = paste0(factor_col, " score")
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5
  )

  p
}
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
factor_clinical <- fread(FACTOR_CLINICAL_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

cat("Factor-clinical table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(factor_clinical))

cat("Columns:\n")
print(colnames(factor_clinical))

factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(factor_clinical), value = TRUE)

cat("Factors found:\n")
print(factor_cols)

if (!"Grade" %in% colnames(factor_clinical)) {
  stop("Column 'Grade' not found in factor-clinical file.")
}

factor_clinical[, Grade_clean := clean_grade(Grade)]

cat("Grade distribution before filtering:\n")
print(factor_clinical[, .N, by = Grade][order(Grade)])

cat("Grade distribution after cleaning:\n")
print(factor_clinical[, .N, by = Grade_clean][order(Grade_clean)])
```

# Identify prioritized grade-associated factors

```{r identify-prioritized-grade-factors}
if (file.exists(PRIORITY_FILE)) {
  priority_hits <- fread(PRIORITY_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

  print(priority_hits)

  grade_factors <- unique(
    priority_hits[
      Annotation == "Grade" &
        Priority %in% c("FDR_global_lt_0.1", "Nominal_p_lt_0.05", "Trend_p_lt_0.1"),
      Factor
    ]
  )

} else {
  warning("Priority file not found. Falling back to Factor5 and Factor6.")
  grade_factors <- c("Factor5", "Factor6")
}

# Safety fallback based on previous result
if (length(grade_factors) == 0) {
  grade_factors <- c("Factor5", "Factor6")
}

grade_factors <- intersect(grade_factors, factor_cols)

cat("Grade-associated factors selected for validation:\n")
print(grade_factors)

if (length(grade_factors) == 0) {
  stop("No grade-associated factors found in factor score table.")
}
```

# Grade II vs Grade III validation

```{r grade-validation-tests}
grade_test_results <- rbindlist(lapply(grade_factors, function(fac) {
  wilcox_effect_summary(factor_clinical, fac, "Grade_clean")
}))

grade_test_results[, FDR := p.adjust(Wilcoxon_P, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  grade_test_results,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_grade_associated_factor_validation_tests.csv")
)

print(grade_test_results)
```

# Save Grade II/III-only analysis table

```{r grade-filtered-table}
grade_filtered <- factor_clinical[
  !is.na(Grade_clean) &
    Grade_clean %in% c("Grade II", "Grade III")
]

grade_filtered[, Grade_clean := factor(Grade_clean, levels = c("Grade II", "Grade III"))]

fwrite(
  grade_filtered,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_factor_scores_clinical_GradeII_GradeIII_only.csv")
)

cat("Grade II/III-only table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(grade_filtered))

cat("Grade II/III sample counts:\n")
print(grade_filtered[, .N, by = Grade_clean])
```

# Plot validated grade-associated factors

```{r plot-grade-factors, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5}
for (fac in grade_factors) {
  make_grade_plot(
    grade_filtered,
    fac,
    file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(fac, "_GradeII_vs_GradeIII_boxplot.pdf"))
  )
}
```

# Export ranked samples by grade-associated factor scores

```{r ranked-samples}
for (fac in grade_factors) {
  ranked_dt <- grade_filtered[
    ,
    c(
      "Sample",
      "Grade",
      "Grade_clean",
      "ER_status",
      "PR_status",
      "HER2_status",
      "HR_status",
      "HR_HER2_subtype",
      "TILs",
      "Tumor_cellularity",
      fac
    ),
    with = FALSE
  ][order(-get(fac))]

  fwrite(
    ranked_dt,
    file.path(TABLE_OUT, paste0("Samples_ranked_by_", fac, ".csv"))
  )

  cat("\nTop samples by ", fac, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(head(ranked_dt, 10))

  cat("\nBottom samples by ", fac, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(tail(ranked_dt, 10))
}
```

# Correlation between Factor5 and Factor6

```{r factor5-factor6-correlation, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
if (all(c("Factor5", "Factor6") %in% colnames(grade_filtered))) {
  cor_test <- cor.test(
    grade_filtered$Factor5,
    grade_filtered$Factor6,
    method = "spearman"
  )

  factor56_cor <- data.table(
    Factor_X = "Factor5",
    Factor_Y = "Factor6",
    Spearman_rho = unname(cor_test$estimate),
    P_value = cor_test$p.value,
    N = sum(is.finite(grade_filtered$Factor5) & is.finite(grade_filtered$Factor6))
  )

  fwrite(
    factor56_cor,
    file.path(TABLE_OUT, "Factor5_Factor6_spearman_correlation.csv")
  )

  print(factor56_cor)

  p <- ggplot(
    grade_filtered,
    aes(
      x = Factor5,
      y = Factor6,
      shape = Grade_clean
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = "Relationship between Factor5 and Factor6",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(factor56_cor$Spearman_rho, 3),
        ", P = ",
        signif(factor56_cor$P_value, 3)
      ),
      x = "Factor5 score",
      y = "Factor6 score",
      shape = "Grade"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(PLOT_DIR, "Factor5_vs_Factor6_by_grade.pdf"),
    p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5
  )
}
```

# Extract top weights for grade-associated factors

```{r top-weights-grade-factors}
if (file.exists(TOP_WEIGHT_FILE)) {
  top_weights <- fread(TOP_WEIGHT_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

  top_weights_grade <- top_weights[factor %in% grade_factors]

  fwrite(
    top_weights_grade,
    file.path(TABLE_OUT, "Top25_feature_weights_for_grade_associated_factors.csv")
  )

  print(top_weights_grade)
} else {
  warning("Top weight file not found: ", TOP_WEIGHT_FILE)
}
```

# Extract top positive and negative weights from all features

```{r top-positive-negative-all-weights}
if (file.exists(ALL_WEIGHT_FILE)) {
  all_weights <- fread(ALL_WEIGHT_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

  grade_weight_details <- rbindlist(lapply(grade_factors, function(fac) {
    tmp <- all_weights[factor == fac]

    rbindlist(lapply(unique(tmp$view), function(vv) {
      vv_dt <- tmp[view == vv]

      top_pos <- vv_dt[order(-value)][1:min(.N, 25)]
      top_pos[, Direction := "Positive_weight"]

      top_neg <- vv_dt[order(value)][1:min(.N, 25)]
      top_neg[, Direction := "Negative_weight"]

      rbind(top_pos, top_neg, fill = TRUE)
    }), fill = TRUE)
  }), fill = TRUE)

  fwrite(
    grade_weight_details,
    file.path(TABLE_OUT, "Top_positive_negative_feature_weights_for_grade_associated_factors.csv")
  )

  print(grade_weight_details)
} else {
  warning("All feature weight file not found: ", ALL_WEIGHT_FILE)
}
```

# Check top-weight features by direction and view

```{r summarize-weight-direction}
if (exists("grade_weight_details")) {
  weight_summary <- grade_weight_details[
    ,
    .N,
    by = .(factor, view, Direction)
  ][order(factor, view, Direction)]

  fwrite(
    weight_summary,
    file.path(TABLE_OUT, "Top_weight_feature_count_by_factor_view_direction.csv")
  )

  print(weight_summary)
}
```

# Create concise interpretation table

```{r concise-interpretation-table}
interpretation_table <- copy(grade_test_results)

interpretation_table[, Association_direction := fifelse(
  Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII > 0,
  "Higher in Grade III",
  fifelse(
    Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII < 0,
    "Higher in Grade II",
    NA_character_
  )
)]

interpretation_table[, Interpretation := paste0(
  Factor,
  " is ",
  Association_direction,
  " compared with the other grade group. ",
  "Median Grade II = ",
  round(Median_Grade_II, 3),
  "; median Grade III = ",
  round(Median_Grade_III, 3),
  "; Wilcoxon P = ",
  signif(Wilcoxon_P, 3),
  "; FDR = ",
  signif(FDR, 3),
  "."
)]

fwrite(
  interpretation_table,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_grade_factor_validation_interpretation_table.csv")
)

print(interpretation_table[, .(
  Factor,
  Association_direction,
  Median_Grade_II,
  Median_Grade_III,
  Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII,
  Wilcoxon_P,
  FDR,
  Interpretation
)])
```
